title: 5 field-cube components with two-sided bounded search

claims.statement: The explicit 5-component degree-200 field-cube encoder with its stated two-sided radius-23/21 decoder for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses has average block error at most 653600617033426561/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 two-sided decoder uses at most W=3562530327158758279851719987355560 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(111457/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact digit-coefficient imbalance envelopes, occupied-volume error, field irreducibility, fixed root circuit and both search counts.
